description: Source code implementing CPU memory allocator classes and profiling utilities for the PyTorch c10 library, including default and mobile-specific allocators, memory profiling, and logging.

classes.name: DefaultCPUAllocator
classes.description: Default CPU memory allocator class implementing at::Allocator interface.

classes.name: DefaultMobileCPUAllocator
classes.description: Mobile-specific CPU allocator with guard bytes for safe out-of-bound access.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size, with special handling for zero bytes and guard bytes.

methods.name: raw_deleter
methods.description: Returns pointer to the delete function for memory deallocation.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Copies data between source and destination buffers.

methods.name: SetCPUAllocator
methods.description: Sets the CPU allocator with specified priority.

methods.name: GetDefaultMobileCPUAllocator
methods.description: Returns the default mobile CPU allocator instance.

methods.name: GetDefaultCPUAllocator
methods.description: Returns the global default CPU allocator instance.

methods.name: ProfiledCPUMemoryReporter::New
methods.description: Records a new memory allocation for profiling.
